Only a small group of customers can try phase 1 (chart builder and saved views) soon. The design-partner beta opens Wednesday, Dec 9, for 5 customers. Those are Orbitly, Zest Grocers and three accounts from the October trial cohort [3].

Everyone else has to wait. Other customers won't get access before general availability, which is targeted for late January [3]. Priya asked the team not to promise access to anyone outside the beta list. A waitlist will open in January [10].

Phase 1 is feature-complete on staging behind the dash_v2 flag. Two items remain: query performance on workspaces above 50M events, and empty states [3].

The Dec 9 date is newer than earlier plans. The Nov 12 sync only said "right after" Dec 4 [1], and the spec said "early December" [2].
